provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-11: Presentation of WebServices V-1.2 (February 2026), Web Service (API1, SOAP) V-5.14 (January 2025, https://storage.mondialrelay.fr/web-service-solution-v514-EN.pdf), Web Service Dual Carrier (API2, REST) V-2.7.1 (June 2024). API1 is the maintained service for relay point searches and tracking; its shipment methods (WSI2_CreationExpedition, WSI2_CreationEtiquette, WSI3_GetEtiquettes) are stopped since V-5.11 (April 2024), 'no longer maintained and should not be used', blocked for the accounts created from 2024-12-23: labels go through API2. The two APIs have different credentials, both from Connect (Administration, Configuration des API): API1 the enseigne and private key, API2 a login, a password and a customer id. Calls: no batch mode, requests spread over the day as end users need them (both APIs; API2: 'No batch script will be allowed'). Tracking: each shipment queried no more than 4 to 6 times a day, never once delivered or returned (EDI or webhooks for more): a limit per parcel, which no scope of the schema counts, so not declared as a rate limit; the caller keeps it. Point search: one call per search, never the whole network, 10 to 30 points, default radius 50 km, at most 75 km (REL) or 100 km (24R, 24L). Labels: API2's labels must not be altered or resized; labels printed by the merchant's own hardware are validated by Mondial Relay first; additional labelling only with its approval. No idempotency key, and OrderNo is free data: a shipment request is sent once, and one lost after it left is looked up in Connect before booking again. No published request rate.
